explanation: Technical abandonment is passive. Re-linking the user directly to a cached checkout step minimises drop-off on slower connections or crash recoveries.

risk_level: Medium (substituting products needs high precision to match customer preferences)
when_not_to_use: When the specific out-of-stock item is highly branded and cannot be reasonably substituted.
alternative_intervention: Enable 'Notify Me' price-drop alert and pin-code stock arrival subscription.
explanation: When delivery or stock blocks purchase, offering near-identical alternatives keeps the customer on platform instead of driving them to competitors.
